title: Meeting People
paragraphs: Sarah berada di sebuah konferensi Islam di kota baru. Ia belum banyak mengenal orang di sini. Ia melihat seorang wanita berdiri sendirian di dekat pintu, dan wanita itu tersenyum kepadanya, jadi Sarah memutuskan untuk menghampiri dan memulai percakapan. "Assalamu'alaikum, saya Sarah," katanya sambil tersenyum hangat. "Wa'alaikumussalam, saya Budi," jawab wanita itu. Mereka berjabat tangan dengan lembut. Keduanya merasa sedikit gugup, tapi senang bisa bertemu orang baru di tempat yang asing.

Budi berasal dari Indonesia, dan Sarah berasal dari Malaysia. Mereka berdua menghadiri sesi pertama mereka, jadi mereka memutuskan duduk bersama dan berbagi catatan. Menjelang akhir hari, mereka bertukar nomor telepon dan berencana untuk tetap berhubungan. Malam itu, Sarah memikirkan bagaimana satu sapaan kecil mengubah seluruh pengalamannya di konferensi tersebut. Percakapan singkat, ia sadari, bisa mengubah orang asing menjadi teman sejati, dan perjalanan yang sepi menjadi perjalanan yang bermakna.
answerKey: Sarah is at an Islamic conference in a new city. She does not know many people here yet. She sees a woman standing alone near the door, and the woman smiles at her, so Sarah decides to walk over and start a conversation. "Assalamu'alaikum, I am Sarah," she says with a warm smile. "Wa'alaikumussalam, I am Budi," the woman replies. They shake hands gently. Both of them feel a little nervous, but glad to meet someone new in an unfamiliar place. Budi is from Indonesia, and Sarah is from Malaysia. They are both attending their first session, so they decide to sit together and share their notes. By the end of the day, they exchange numbers and plan to keep in touch. Later that evening, Sarah thinks about how one small greeting changed her whole experience of the conference. A short conversation, she realizes, can turn a stranger into a genuine friend, and a lonely trip into a meaningful one.
